### Top forum threads

What do you think? …

Sid Menon

Hey Product Hunt!  
  
Whiteboard is an open-source desktop app where humans and agents architect software together on a shared canvas. It’s the easiest way to ship fast with coding agents while still understanding your codebase.

We made Whiteboard because coding with agents was exhausting: we were constantly switching between the terminal, our IDEs, and HTML visualizations to give feedback on the walls of text we were squinting at all day.

Whiteboard plugs into the tools you already use - Claude Code, Codex, etc. - and gives your agent an SDK to draw on a persistent, in-app canvas. The app is designed to capture the feeling of a productive whiteboard session with another engineer. [...] Whiteboard
